summary: For k = 0 take A = chosenLevel; for k > 0 take A = K₀. In both cases apply exists_cut_coverMultiplicity_dvd; for k > 0 the compact set D consists of finitely many local corrections at Q (valuation profiles in [−k, k]) times K₀, and the points where stage k does not vanish are moved into D by B_f because their lattices have near lines (hasNearLines_of_unfoldStage_ne_zero) and then a Witt-type orbit argument (exists_mem_besselFin). (Lines 39–43 are the rest of the statement after its `let Y :=`; the line census reads them as part of the value, so they stand in the introduction.)

steps.claim: Let Y = gradingY(k); write the integrality conditions as membership in intersections of subgroups.

k = 0: take A = chosenLevel, a level; D.columnLevel(0) maps into it (columnLevel_zero_eq_comap and the description of the principal level of the filling). For each ϑ apply exists_cut_coverMultiplicity_dvd with J = levelY(ϑ, 0) ≤ chosenLevel, D = A (compact), B = localLevel ∩ chosenLevel ⊇ A, the exponent 0 (conjugation by elements of A keeps J in A), and W the non-vanishing of stage 0, where some r ∈ B_f moves x into the level (exists_besselFin_mul_mem_of_ne_zero).
steps.lean:
· exact ⟨D.chosenLevel, inferInstance, fun a h ↦ D.filling_fits.mem_stdPrincipalLevel_iff.2
      (D.filling_fits.finiteEquiv_inclX (1, a) ▸ D.columnLevel_zero_eq_comap.le h), fun ϑ
      ↦ have b := (by simp [levelOf_le_Kf.trans Kf_le_localLevel]); exists_cut_coverMultiplicity_dvd
        (levelY_le_chosenLevel ..) IsLevel.isCompact
      b (fun x a ↦ ⟨b a, 0, fun u b ↦ by simp_all [mul_mem, levelY_le_chosenLevel _ _ b]⟩) fun x ⟨_,
        _, _, _, _, e, _⟩ ↦ (D.filling_fits.exists_besselFin_mul_mem_of_ne_zero _ e :)⟩

steps.claim: For every point x choose an adapted basis b(x) at x with string diagonal β(x) (exists_isAdaptedAt).
steps.lean: choose b β hb using Y.exists_isAdaptedAt

steps.claim: If x and y have the same component at w, then β(x) and the diagonal of any adapted basis at y have the same valuations at w (ideleLogVal_eq).
steps.lean:
have l {x y b β w} (h : Y.IsAdaptedAt y b β) (e : x.atPlace w = y.atPlace w) :=
    (hb x).ideleLogVal_eq h (by simpa)

steps.claim: For a finite set Q let Φ_Q(d)(i, w) = ideleLogVal(β(d)_i)_w − ideleLogVal(β(1)_i)_w for w ∈ Q ∪ Q̄: the valuation profile at d relative to that at 1.
steps.lean: let Φ Q d i (w : ↥(star '' Q ∪ Q)) := ideleLogVal (β d i) w.1 - ideleLogVal (β 1 i) w.1

steps.claim: At x = 1 with Q = ∅, HasNearLines holds (hasNearLines_zero with the lattice of gradingY(k)): the diagonal at 1 has exactly the valuations of (a/ā)^{…}·c_i (f, n).
steps.lean:
have ⟨_, _, f, n⟩ :=
    Y.hasNearLines_zero (D.spansLattice_gradingY ..) le_rfl (x := 1) (Q := ∅) ⟨1, by simp⟩

steps.claim: k ≠ 0: take A = K₀ and, for each ϑ, apply exists_cut_coverMultiplicity_dvd:
steps.lean:
refine ⟨Kf .., inferInstance, fun _ ↦ (Y.inclXFin_mem_Kf (D.spansLattice_gradingY ..)
    D.piIdele_spec ·.2), fun ϑ ↦ exists_cut_coverMultiplicity_dvd levelOf_le_Kf (((Set.finite_Icc
    (-↑k) ↑k).image (componentOn _ ϑ.Q ∘ invFun (Φ ϑ.Q))).isCompact.mul isCompact_Kf) (by simp [e,
    Kf_le_localLevel]) (fun x ⟨_, ⟨y, _, rfl⟩, z, hz, d⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨fun w o ↦ by simp [← d,
    mem_Kf_iff.1 hz, not_or.1 (o <| D.levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q ϑ · |>.1)],
    by simp [e]⟩, (ϑ.Q.eventually_all.2 fun w o ↦ (eventually_localCongruence_subset (((isOpen_Kw
    w).preimage (continuous_conj (x.atPlace w))).mem_nhds (by simp))).mono fun n H u (hu :
    u ∈ levelY ϑ k) ↦ H (pow_pow_mem_localCongruence (D.levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q ϑ
    (.inl o)).1 (mem_localCongruence_zero.2 ⟨mem_Kf_iff.1 (levelOf_le_Kf hu) w,
    congrFun (mem_levelOf.1 hu).2 (.inr ⟨w, o⟩)⟩) n)).exists.imp fun n H u hu ↦ mem_Kf_iff.2 fun w ↦
    by_contra fun a ↦ a ?_⟩) fun x ⟨_, r, _, _, _, b, a⟩ ↦ (hasNearLines_of_unfoldStage_ne_zero ϑ _
    _ ⟨_, r⟩ a _ _ _ b).elim fun _ ⟨_, g, o⟩ ↦ by clear * - o n l g f hb; exact
    (g.exists_mem_besselFin (hb _) (by grind [l g, atPlace_componentOn, by
    simpa [funext_iff] using invFun_eq (f := Φ ϑ.Q) ⟨x, rfl⟩])).elim fun z a ↦ ⟨_,
    a.2, _, ⟨Φ _ x, by simp [Pi.le_def]; grind, rfl⟩, z, a.1, eq_mul_of_mul_inv_eq rfl⟩⟩

steps.claim: A = K₀ is a level, and D.columnLevel(k) lies in the preimage of K₀ under inclXFin_Y (inclXFin_mem_Kf: the congruence condition modulo π, with π a uniformiser at the π-places).

For ϑ: J = levelY(ϑ, k) ≤ K₀; the compact set D = (componentOn_Q ∘ invFun Φ_Q)(profiles with values in [−k, k]) · K₀ (finitely many local corrections at Q times the compact K₀); B = localLevel (away from n) ⊇ K₀ (k ≠ 0).
steps.lean:
fun ϑ ↦ exists_cut_coverMultiplicity_dvd levelOf_le_Kf (((Set.finite_Icc
    (-↑k) ↑k).image (componentOn _ ϑ.Q ∘ invFun (Φ ϑ.Q))).isCompact.mul isCompact_Kf) (by simp [e,
    Kf_le_localLevel])

steps.claim: Every x = (correction)·z ∈ D is integral at the places not dividing n: the correction is supported on Q ∪ Q̄, whose places divide n, and z ∈ K₀.
steps.lean:
(fun x ⟨_, ⟨y, _, rfl⟩, z, hz, d⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨fun w o ↦ by simp [← d,
    mem_Kf_iff.1 hz, not_or.1 (o <| D.levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q ϑ · |>.1)],
    by simp [e]⟩,

steps.claim: For x ∈ D there is n′ with (x u x⁻¹)^{n^{n′}} ∈ K₀ for all u ∈ 𝒥_k: at each w ∈ Q, u lies in the local congruence subgroup at w, and high n-powers of conjugates of such elements fall into any neighbourhood, here the conjugate of K_w (pow_pow_mem_localCongruence); the membership elsewhere is left for step 9.
steps.lean:
(ϑ.Q.eventually_all.2 fun w o ↦ (eventually_localCongruence_subset (((isOpen_Kw
    w).preimage (continuous_conj (x.atPlace w))).mem_nhds (by simp))).mono fun n H u (hu :
    u ∈ levelY ϑ k) ↦ H (pow_pow_mem_localCongruence (D.levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q ϑ
    (.inl o)).1 (mem_localCongruence_zero.2 ⟨mem_Kf_iff.1 (levelOf_le_Kf hu) w,
    congrFun (mem_levelOf.1 hu).2 (.inr ⟨w, o⟩)⟩) n)).exists.imp fun n H u hu ↦ mem_Kf_iff.2 fun w ↦
    by_contra fun a ↦ a ?_⟩)

steps.claim: W: if stage k does not vanish at (g, x) for a ramified φ, then x has near lines (hasNearLines_of_unfoldStage_ne_zero): its valuation profile on Q ∪ Q̄ lies in [−k, k] and vanishes elsewhere. The correction with the same profile has adapted bases with the same first-half valuations everywhere (steps 5, 7), so exists_mem_besselFin gives z ∈ K₀ and r ∈ B_f with r·x = (correction)·z ∈ D.
steps.lean:
fun x ⟨_, r, _, _, _, b, a⟩ ↦ (hasNearLines_of_unfoldStage_ne_zero ϑ _
    _ ⟨_, r⟩ a _ _ _ b).elim fun _ ⟨_, g, o⟩ ↦ by clear * - o n l g f hb; exact
    (g.exists_mem_besselFin (hb _) (by grind [l g, atPlace_componentOn, by
    simpa [funext_iff] using invFun_eq (f := Φ ϑ.Q) ⟨x, rfl⟩])).elim fun z a ↦ ⟨_,
    a.2, _, ⟨Φ _ x, by simp [Pi.le_def]; grind, rfl⟩, z, a.1, eq_mul_of_mul_inv_eq rfl⟩⟩

steps.claim: The membership left in 8.4: outside Q ∪ Q̄ the correction is 1 and u ∈ K₀, and at Q the power lies in K_w; so the power lies in K₀.
steps.lean:
simp [mem_Kf_iff.1 hz, ← d, mem_supportedOn.1 componentOn_mem_supportedOn w
    (a <| by simpa using H w · u hu) (a <| atPlace_star_mem_iff.1 <| by simpa using H _ · u hu),
    mul_mem, pow_mem (mem_Kf_iff.1 (levelOf_le_Kf hu) _)]
